2026

Author: Gurpal Singh Ahluwalia
Bench: G. S. Ahluwalia

Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Gwl:4474
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice G. S. Ahluwalia
 On The 4 th Of February, 2026
 Civil Revision No. 1161 of 2025
 Magma General Insurance Co.Ltd
 Versus
 Dwarika And Others

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Mr. Naresh Singh Tomar - Advocate for applicant.
Mr. Vijay Pratap Singh Tomar - Advocate for responden

Order 
This civil revision under Section 115 of CPC has been filed against the award dated 18/08/2025 passed by 15th Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Gwalior in MACC No. 1002/2022 by which applicant/insurance company was exonerated.
However, principle of "pay and recover" was applied.

2. Challenging the application of principle of "pay and recover", it is submitted by counsel for applicant that once the insurance company has been exonerated, then the Claims Tribunal should not have applied the principle of "pay and recover".
3.

4. This Court in the case of Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Ltd. Registered Office Hari Nivas Towers Vs. Munni Bai and others decided on 11/03/2025 in MA No.5819/2024 (Gwalior) has held that NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:4474 2 CR-1161-2025 even after amendment in the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, still the Claims Tribunal has jurisdiction to apply the principle of "pay and recover".
5.

entities.text: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Ltd. Registered Office Hari Nivas Towers Vs. Munni Bai and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Since the case in hand is duly covered by the order passed by this Court in the case of Munni Bai Magma General Insurance Co.Ltd vs Dwarika on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50112823/
1 (supra) , therefore, this Court is of considered opinion that no case is made out warranting interference in the impugned award.

1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
6 . Ex-consequenti, award dated 18/08/2025 passed by 15 th Motor Accident Claims Tribunal,
Gwalior in MACC No. 1002/2022 is hereby affirmed.
7. Civil revision fails and is hereby dismissed.
However, it is observed that dismissal of this revision would not mean that this Court has upheld the quantum of compensation amount or exoneration of the insurance company.

Therefore, it is observed that in case if the owner of offending vehicle files a civil revision against the exoneration of insurance company or the claimant files a miscellaneous appeal for enhancement of compensation amount, then this order will not come in the way of such proceedings.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE AKS Magma General Insurance Co.Ltd vs Dwarika on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50112823/
